title: GraphQL Subscriptions over WebSockets — Companion Code
title_es: Suscripciones GraphQL sobre WebSockets — Código complementario
description: Runnable Apollo Server + graphql-ws + PubSub setup: real HTTP and WebSocket servers on one port, createPost/updatePost mutations publishing events, a withFilter per-subscriber filter, an end-to-end demo that subscribes over WS and triggers mutations over HTTP, and vitest coverage.
description_es: Montaje ejecutable con Apollo Server + graphql-ws + PubSub: servidores HTTP y WebSocket reales en un puerto, mutaciones createPost/updatePost que publican eventos, filtro por suscriptor con withFilter, demo end-to-end que se suscribe por WS y dispara mutaciones por HTTP, y tests vitest.
